L01: First time in Singapore? Leave some room in the plan.
Give three days to three routes.

Drop your bags, then begin at Marina Bay.
L03: On day one, follow the waterfront:
the Merlion, Marina Bay Sands, and Gardens by the Bay.
L04: See the skyline by day, and save the Supertrees for evening.

Start with Chinatown shophouses, then a meal at Maxwell Food Centre.
L06: Continue to Little India, then Kampong Glam.
Sultan Mosque and Haji Lane fit into the same walk.
L07: Take the metro between districts, and walk within them.
Leave time for side streets, instead of another taxi ride.
L08: From HarbourFront, head through VivoCity for the Sentosa Express,
L09: Choose one focus: beach time or Universal Studios Singapore.
Give the theme park room, instead of packing two days into one.
L10: Contactless bank cards make transit simple.

L11: Carry an umbrella and water. Walk early or late.
Save midday for hawker centres and indoor sights,

L12: First the bay, then the neighbourhoods, and finally, time by the sea.
